L0H0_ATTN.hypothesis: L0H0_ATTN spreads attention across 2-4 positions with content-dependent weights, summarising neighbourhood information rather than copying from one specific position.

L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP fuses its own position's token embedding with the L0H0_ATTN write (mean write-diff=2.05 when L0H0 ablated), combining two distinct upstream signals.

L1_MLP.hypothesis: L1_MLP fuses at least two distinct upstream signals: the L0_MLP write (mean write-diff=10.57 when L0_MLP ablated) plus the position's own token embedding.

L2H0_ATTN.hypothesis: L2H0_ATTN attends with 1.000 weight to the swap-partner position (pos1<->pos2, pos3<->pos4, etc.) regardless of token content, copying content via purely positional indexing.
